'''Ugali''', a porridge-like dish made with maize meal, is a staple dish in Kenya and in Tanzania. 

==Ingredients==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] white [[Cookbook:Cornmeal|cornmeal]] or ground [[Cookbook:Maize|maize ]]
* 8 cups water
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste (optional)

==Procedure==

#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the water in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
#Add salt if desired, and pour the corn flour slowly into boiling water, stirring continuously. Try to mash up any lumps that do form—the aim is to get a smooth consistency. A [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] makes this easier, as does [[Cookbook:Sifting|sifting]] the flour.
#Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until it has the consistency of thick oatmeal.
#Serve hot ugali immediately with any meat or vegetable stew, or any dish with a sauce or gravy.
